finding.symptom: I use the bank site on my phone. I can see my accounts and my statement. I cannot send money: there is nothing to press on the transfer part of the page. On my laptop it works. My phone is two years old and the screen is small.
finding.hypothesis: The transfer button is hidden on small screens. The CSS media query at line 181 hides the send-button on screens smaller than 430px. This causes the user to be unable to send money on small phones.

severity.reason: customers cannot send money on small screens

priority.reason: affects core functionality on mobile devices

finding.symptom: I tried to send 50 from my euro account to my friend's account. The site said the destination account was not found or cannot receive this transfer. I checked the number three times and it is right. My friend says her account is in yen. Is your system broken?
finding.hypothesis: The system rejects transfers to accounts of a different currency. The user tried to send euros to a yen account. The error message does not mention currency mismatch, but the check in api.py line 223 is strict about currency.

severity.reason: customers cannot send money to friends in different currencies
